data: NVIDIA delivered an exceptional fiscal 2022, with revenue rising 61.4% to $26.9 billion from $16.7 billion in fiscal 2021. Profitability expanded even faster, as net income grew 125.1% to $9.8 billion in fiscal 2022 from $4.3 billion in fiscal 2021, signaling strong operating leverage. Cash generation kept pace: operating cash flow reached $9.1 billion in fiscal 2022, up from $5.8 billion in fiscal 2021, while cash and cash equivalents rose to $2.0 billion from $0.8 billion. The balance sheet grew substantially, with total assets climbing to $44.2 billion in fiscal 2022 from $28.8 billion in fiscal 2021. Total liabilities also increased, to $17.6 billion from $11.9 billion, but remained well below the asset base. Overall, fiscal 2022 results point to robust demand and improving earnings quality, supporting a constructive view on the shares.
